title: Dragon Boat Team Portal
description: Operations portal a 50-person team uses every week: attendance forms, weight-balanced boat lineups, and carpool assignment. Multi-team isolation enforced in Postgres with row-level security across 8 migrations, policies, and RPCs. Sign-up friction was killing response rates, so I moved to passwordless email sign-in with anonymous shared form links. Deployment is private because member profiles hold home addresses.

title: Carpool Optimizer
description: Cuts club ride-planning time an estimated 30% with automated seat assignment and pickup-order route optimization. Greedy nearest-neighbor assignment that preserves manual seat picks as hard constraints while respecting per-car capacity and absences. Per-car color-coded routes rendered over self-hosted OSRM, with a runtime toggle to the public API.

title: F1 Telemetry App
description: FastAPI WebSocket service that unpacks live F1 2020 UDP telemetry into speed, throttle, brake, and per-wheel slip. The first version dropped frames because every packet hit React state, so I decoupled ingest from render with a client packet queue drained at a fixed 20 FPS.

title: Oversteer Detector
description: Fine-tuned VideoMAE to classify oversteer, understeer, and neutral over 972 labeled 60-frame driving clips I built and annotated myself. Interpolated positional embeddings from 16 to 60 frames and cut trainable parameters to 1.3M of 88M with LoRA on query and value projections. Validation loss down 24%.

title: Gaming PC Benchmarking
description: Instrumentation study from my Stanford research work. NumPy and SciPy pipeline over HWiNFO64 logs sampled every 2 seconds, cleaning CPU and GPU telemetry across 6 test runs. Welch's t-tests on an added intake fan: CPU temps fell 1.3 degrees C (p < 0.001) while GPU deltas stayed insignificant. I presented the null result.

title: 3D Space Planner
description: Lightweight CAD tool for visualizing 3D spaces, built entirely in React. Inspired by trying to lay out a small dorm room.

title: Dragon Boat Lineup Maker
description: Standalone lineup builder that pulls the roster from a published Google Sheet and supports drag-and-drop, race and practice layouts, and weight-based sorting. Superseded by the team portal above, kept here as the earlier iteration.

title: NutriAI
description: SF Hacks 2025 submission. Meal and water planner using prompt tuning against the Gemini API, packaged for Android with Buildozer.

title: Socioeconomic Outages
description: Analysis of how socioeconomic factors relate to power outage impact, from raw data cleaning through model training and evaluation.

title: Secret Scanner
description: React web app that flags likely API keys in pasted text or a GitHub repo, with a confidence score per match rather than a binary hit.

title: WuGraph
description: Graph implementation written to practice object-oriented design, data structures, and traversal algorithms.

title: TextExcel
description: Terminal spreadsheet in Java: cell references, formula parsing, and arithmetic evaluation.

title: College Data Project
description: Cal Hacks 11.0 submission in Java, and the project where I learned to parse CSV files and turn raw data into something a program could use.
